title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Ava Martinez
description: Automate TLS certificate rotation and KMS/HSM key lifecycle for private deployments. This PR wires together Helm chart templating, Terraform key modules, and the private-installer upgrade flow to provide a safe, automated rotation path for TLS certificates and KMS/HSM keys used by the control plane and agents. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private require automated cert/key rotation for compliance (SOC2/ISO) and to reduce operational burden for long-lived on-prem clusters. This change introduces: (1) a Terraform module update that supports rotation-triggered key versions and optional HSM-backed key creation; (2) Helm chart hooks and templating changes to support rolling certificate updates with preStop hooks and readiness gating; (3) sealed-secrets and Vault integration paths so customers can select their secret backend; (4) an idempotent installer upgrade command (installer/upgrade.sh) that orchestrates Terraform apply, waits for key promotion, and flips certs with graceful rollout; (5) tests and smoke-checks for both HA and single-node install profiles. The description below documents the workflow, operator flags, and rollback considerations. Workflow: operator runs `installer/upgrade.sh --rotate-tls --kms-policy rotate --backend vault|sealed-secrets`, script runs terraform plan/app to create new key material (or key version), optionally provisions HSM key via cloud HSM module, writes encrypted artifacts to Vault or sealed-secrets, patches helm release with new cert/key secret references, waits for healthy rolling restart using readiness checks, then promotes the new key version and removes old key material after a configurable grace period. Safeguards: - Terraform plan is validated and output is inspected before apply in non-confirm mode. - Helm hooks use canary rollout (configurable percentage) for control-plane components. - Rollback is supported by re-applying previous secret refs and promoting prior key versions. Related: shares design with ENG-1289 and integrates Terraform module added in ENG-1304. See linked Linear tickets for eval prompts and QA checklist.
